critical_code_review_comments: Same dev-only hydration warning already documented in iter_40 still present (<span data-ve-dynamic> injected as child of <option> in AITradingPanel selects). Explicitly declared 'kein Bug' by review_request; only concerns dev overlay/hot-reload build.

AITradingPanel.js now ~1957 lines. Guard-Cockpit UI (~24 lines) is a good candidate to extract together with Token-Verbrauch and Fee-Guard-Stats into a small SetupStatsSection component in future refactor.

Guard-cockpit endpoint groups by string substring on blocked_by (pat in why). Works today because all block messages are stable German prefixes, but is brittle -- a future rename of e.g. 'Korrelations-Guard:' to 'Korrelation:' would silently reclassify the block as 'Sonstige'. Consider tagging blocks with an explicit guard_key alongside blocked_by.
seed_data_creation: None on Dev-DB. test_guard_cockpit.py creates+drops its own ephemeral DB (crypto_scanner_dev_test_guard_cockpit). PROD_MONGO_URL untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guard-Cockpit endpoint /api/ai/guard-stats is public (no auth), keeps 10 guard entries in fixed order [weekend,stale,regime,correlation,direction,cluster,playbook,master,fee,other] + regime_shadow with would_block_live counting only live signals (data_collection!=True) whose entry_market_snapshot.features.regime is in ai_engine.config.regime_block_list. days clamped 1..90. Frontend fetches it via loadInsights when Setup opens; block appears just before <AITraderReset/>. Reusable API pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_guard_cockpit_api.py.
